image_description: A white and black airship (dirigible) floating in a clear blue sky. The airship has an elongated, cigar-shaped hull with a pointed nose and a red vertical stabilizer fin at the tail. A gondola is suspended beneath the forward section of the hull. There is text written on the side of the airship that appears to be gibberish or stylized non-Latin characters.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible profile exhibits strong bilateral symmetry and the aspect ratio is significantly greater than 1:1, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct gondola structure is visible hanging from the underside of the forward half of the airship.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gas-filled hull with stability fins at tail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Smooth tapered hull with pointed nose cone.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the black band is nonsensical. It mimics the shape of letters but fails to form readable words, exhibiting characteristic AI-generated text artifacts where character structures melt into each other.
The tail fins lack structural clarity. The horizontal stabilizers are either missing or poorly defined, blending into the hull rather than standing out as distinct rigid surfaces.
The details of the gondola are slightly muddy and lack sharp mechanical definition. Connections between the gondola and the hull are somewhat indistinct.
